title: Sail Rourkela Apprentice Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Apprenticeship training posts at SAIL Rourkela Steel Plant under Apprentices Act
qualification: ITI / Diploma / Graduation as per trade and apprentice category in official notification
ageLimit: As per SAIL RSP apprenticeship advertisement
applicationFee: As per SAIL / NATS portal rules (often nil)
selectionProcess: Merit based on marks / as per notification → Document Verification → Medical → Training
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, ITI/Diploma marksheets, Aadhaar, photo, bank details, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit SAIL Rourkela / NATS apprenticeship portal linked in notification
2. Register and select Rourkela Steel Plant apprenticeship
3. Fill online form for Trade / Graduate / Technician category
4. Upload documents and submit
5. Keep application printout for verification
shortDescription: SAIL Rourkela Apprentice Online Form 2026. Apply for trade/graduate/technician apprenticeship at RSP.
content:
Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) – Rourkela Steel Plant has invited online applications for Apprentice 2026 (Trade / Graduate / Technician as notified).

Selection is generally merit-based. Candidates should apply only through the official link mentioned in the SAIL RSP advertisement and complete document verification if shortlisted.
